description: RR-105: schema locations that no qualification deck has to use, each with a one-line reason. Read by scripts/check-format-coverage.mjs; a location is written as the check prints it (for example "TextRun.oneOf[1].cite" or "Chart.type = \"world\""). An entry that a deck covers, or that the schema no longer has, fails the check. Every location is covered at the time of writing, so the list is empty: prefer a coverage deck to an entry here.
